answer: Make each new identity lock a small stake that only vests after its work passes graders drawn at random, like marbles from a bag, via a public beacon, so an attacker can't pick friendly jurors. A sybil orchard of 1,000 fake agents must lock 1,000 stakes and wait several epochs before any harvest. Meanwhile a public atlas of who graded whom flags clusters that only vouch for each other, and their stakes are slashed, making the farm cost more than it earns.
